ROOT CAUSE
[PRIMARY] The clocks of ipa01.lab.test and ipa02.lab.test are 900 s apart - confidence HIGH
ipa01.lab.test's clock is 900 s ahead of ipa02.lab.test's, measured from ipa02.lab.test's HTTPS Date header; Kerbe
ros refuses more than 300 s. Which clock is wrong is not established from here: ipa02.lab.test's time service can only b
e checked on ipa02.lab.test.
Impact: Kerberos (GSSAPI) replication between them fails whenever a new ticket is needed; logins that cross them f
ail too.
Chain: ipa01.lab.test's clock differs from ipa02.lab.test's by 900 s
Stops here: which clock is wrong is not established from here
HANDOFF (the remaining evidence is on another server; nothing was changed)
On ipa02.lab.test run:
sudo ipa-diagnose replication --peer ipa01.lab.test
Why: The clocks of ipa01.lab.test and ipa02.lab.test are 900 s apart. ipa02.lab.test's time service can only be checke
d on ipa02.lab.test. Nothing was changed on ipa01.lab.test or ipa02.lab.test; ipa-diagnose never changes another server.
RESOLUTION (only for causes on this server)
For 'The clocks of ipa01.lab.test and ipa02.lab.test are 900 s apart': no fix is printed. No clock change is printed:
which clock is wrong is not established from one server, and stepping an IPA server's clock (in particular backwards) ca
n break Kerberos tickets and replication in other ways. Check the time service on both servers (chronyc tracking, chrony
c sources, timedatectl; read-only) and correct the one that is wrong.
NEXT READ-ONLY STEPS
chronyc tracking; chronyc sources (read-only, here)
on ipa02.lab.test: chronyc tracking; timedatectl (read-only)

LIMITATIONS
Replication is directional and per suffix: this server sees its OWN outbound agreements. The reverse direction is only
reported when it could be read from the peer (read-only, with your own Kerberos ticket); otherwise it is NOT VERIFIED a
nd a handoff to the peer is printed.
Nothing is changed on this server or any other; no command runs on another server; fixes are printed only for causes o
n this server, and only when every safety gate passes.
